correctness.rationale: The weighted Boolean hypercubes glued at one root exactly enumerate all physical PXP allowed configurations. Local Walsh eigenvectors give d_i and a_i. A zero-energy vector satisfies H_i v_i=alpha_i|root> with sum alpha_i=0. Kernel-bearing cubes force alpha_i=0; invertible cubes have zero diagonal root inverse by chiral symmetry, so c=0 and only q-1 root-source directions survive. Counting local root-zero kernels gives both nullity branches. A minimum-norm root-one vector assembled from local projected roots proves the global root-projector reciprocal-sum formula. The finite-dimensional spectral theorem gives the amplitude Cesàro average. Exact rational full-matrix calculations pass 17 kernel/projection cases and 24 independently constructed resolvent comparisons; logs are checked against runnable code, not used as an infinite proof.

Its existence is controlled by a nontrivial simultaneous equal-signed-subset-sum condition across *all* parts; the result identifies the complete kernel, exact amplitude-average weight, and a drive-tuned resonance where a positive perturbation eliminates the zero-frequency atom. This supplies a reusable exact many-body spectral benchmark beyond homogeneous parity counts for infinitely many graphs and arbitrary inhomogeneous positive real couplings, with no claim about finite-time discontinuities.
